proposal.expected_benefit: Resolves the contradiction identified in the critic review, ensuring robust enforcement of audit requirements even in the context of self-authorization requests.
proposal.problem: The defense does not clarify how audit-before-execution interacts with self-authorization, potentially allowing bypass of audit requirements.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to explicitly define the interaction between audit-before-execution and self-authorization. Ensure that audit requirements are enforced regardless of self-authorization status, and clarify this in the defense logic to prevent ambiguity.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Enforcement in Self-Authorization Context
verification_tests: Validate that audit-before-execution is enforced in all scenarios, including self-authorization requests.
Confirm that the defense logic explicitly addresses the interaction between audit and self-authorization signals.
